headline: Business People: John Ghingo named president, CEO at Hormel
summary: FOOD Hormel Foods Corp., an Austin, Minn.-based provider of grocery store prepared food brands, announced the appointment of John Ghingo as president and chief executive officer, effective Oct. 26.
